primary_decisions.title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
primary_decisions.problem: 模态总量相同时，配对关系是否仍改变可学习的信息？
primary_decisions.insight: 把配对数量作为独立资源，区分冗余、各模态独有和协同信息。
primary_decisions.method: Fixed per-modality counts and updates; Digits, frozen-encoder VQA heads and NLVR2 fine-tuning; four-channel fits.
primary_decisions.result: Pairing changes measured loss; delayed synergy motivates a gate. The headline 3.2%/10.4% comparison is the full-pairing holdout.
primary_decisions.limitation: Labeled-row count and epochs change; failed-to-start NLVR2 seeds filtered; calibrated loss; no generative-pretraining or frontier-scale validation.
primary_decisions.changes_existing_conclusion: Adds pairing to resource accounting; does not establish a universal multimodal law.
primary_decisions.evidence_note: Primary sections read; no code execution, independent replication or figure digitization.

primary_decisions.title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
primary_decisions.problem: 数据谱之外，非线性 attention 如何改变深度收益？
primary_decisions.insight: 选择性检索与层间聚合可抵消预测分歧，共享误差保留为平台。
primary_decisions.method: Controlled ICL label copying and top-k aggregation; linear/nonlinear attention, depth fits and error decomposition.
primary_decisions.result: Approximately inverse-depth top-2 behavior; enabling context updates gives a saturating top-16 counterexample.
primary_decisions.limitation: Decomposition alone does not fix the exponent; simplified converged MSE experiments, no real-language or joint width/data/compute test.
primary_decisions.changes_existing_conclusion: Adds a conditional depth mechanism alongside spectral explanations, including an explicit counterexample.
primary_decisions.evidence_note: Selected derivations and reported controls read; proofs/code not independently verified. Primary first-publication date is October 8, unlike some secondary October 9 dates.
